name: atbltd-health-monorepo
description: Healthcare fintech platform for Bangladesh with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend.

scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/backend run lint && npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/backend test && npm --prefix apps/frontend test
scripts.test:cov: npm --prefix apps/backend run test:cov && npm --prefix apps/frontend run test:cov
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/frontend run typecheck
